name: io.github.swayammaheshwari/docstar-mcp
title: Docstar
description: Publish your API docs so AI assistants can look up endpoints and call your API correctly.

tools.name: search_docstar_docs
tools.description: Search DocStar's documentation and guides with a natural-language question, e.g. "how do I add a custom domain to my docs?" or "how does sign-in work on my MCP server?". Returns the most relevant passages with their page URLs. Use it for how-to and concept questions about DocStar. To find an API endpoint to call, use get_docstar_api_docs instead.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "how do I send a WhatsApp template message"

collectionIds.description: Always send exactly these collection ids, unchanged: they are the documentation sites searched.

tools.name: get_docstar_api_docs
tools.description: Browse the DocStar API reference one level at a time, when no dedicated tool on this server does what the user needs. Call it with {} for the top level: the modules (Collections, Pages, Endpoints, Published Versions, MCP Server, FAQs, Changelogs, Webhooks, URL Mappings, ...) with a short description and the endpoints they hold. Call it with `path` set to a module's link to see inside it, and with an endpoint's link ending in ".openapi.yml" to get that endpoint as an OpenAPI file: method, url, headers, query params, path variables, a body example and sample responses. Fetch only the level you need, and reuse what you already fetched.

path.description: A link from a listing, exactly as given (e.g. "https://docs.example.com/sms/llms.txt" or ".../sms/send-sms.openapi.yml"), or just the path ("sms", "sms/send-sms.openapi.yml"). Leave it out for the top level.

tools.name: call_any_api_of_docstar
tools.description: Send a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE request to any DocStar API endpoint for the signed-in user and return { status, ok, headers, data }. Use it for changes no dedicated tool covers, once you know the exact endpoint: from the quickstart-docstar skill's recipes, or looked up with get_docstar_api_docs. For GET requests use call_any_read_api_of_docstar. Never guess a URL. Pass the full url with path variables filled in, the method, the headers the endpoint's docs list, query params in `query` (not in the url) and the JSON body in `body`. Send the endpoint's auth header with an empty value "": the user's token is filled in automatically. Never put a token there yourself. Show the user what you're about to send and get a yes before any call that creates, changes, publishes or deletes something.

url.description: Full endpoint URL with path variables replaced by real values, e.g. https://api.example.com/users/42. Put query params in `query`, not here.

headers.description: Request headers as name/value pairs, as the docs list them. Give the auth header (Authorization, proxy_auth_token, x-api-key, ...) an empty value "" so the signed-in user's token is filled in, or only the scheme the docs put before the token, e.g. "Bearer" for "Authorization: Bearer <token>"; never put a token here yourself. Pass {} when the endpoint needs no headers. Example: {"proxy_auth_token": "", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

query.description: Query params as name/value pairs; an array sends the param once per item. Example: {"type": "flow", "bringflows": true}

method.description: HTTP method from the endpoint's docs

body.description: JSON request body, as the endpoint's docs show it. Leave it out when the endpoint takes no body.

tools.name: call_any_read_api_of_docstar
tools.description: Read from any DocStar API endpoint with a GET request for the signed-in user and return { status, ok, headers, data }. Use it for lookups no dedicated tool covers, once you know the exact endpoint: from the quickstart-docstar skill's recipes, or looked up with get_docstar_api_docs. Never guess a URL. Pass the full url with path variables filled in, the headers the endpoint's docs list, and query params in `query` (not in the url). Send the endpoint's auth header with an empty value "": the user's token is filled in automatically. Never put a token there yourself.

url.description: Full endpoint URL with path variables replaced by real values, e.g. https://api.example.com/users/42. Put query params in `query`, not here.

headers.description: Request headers as name/value pairs, as the docs list them. Give the auth header (Authorization, proxy_auth_token, x-api-key, ...) an empty value "" so the signed-in user's token is filled in, or only the scheme the docs put before the token, e.g. "Bearer" for "Authorization: Bearer <token>"; never put a token here yourself. Pass {} when the endpoint needs no headers. Example: {"proxy_auth_token": "", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

query.description: Query params as name/value pairs; an array sends the param once per item. Example: {"type": "flow", "bringflows": true}

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the collections (docs sites) in an organization, with each one's id, name, type and the caller's permission (1 read, 2 read-write). Each collection also has rootParentId: the parent pageId to use with create_page for a top-level page. Get orgId from list_organizations. Pass exclude=runCollection,environment to keep the response small. Ask the user which collection to work in.

exclude.description: Comma-separated list of collection columns to exclude from the response (e.g. large JSON fields). e.g. runCollection,environment

tools.name: get_mcp_server
tools.description: Get a collection's MCP server: the url end users connect to, ready-to-paste snippets (a Claude Code command and a JSON config), callbackUrls for the OAuth app, the sign-in setup and any custom domain. Creates the server if it's missing and syncs its tools with the published endpoints. Call it after publishing to hand the user their MCP URL.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description:
Creates a new documentation collection in the organization together with its invisible root page (type 0), auto-assigns collection permissions to all org users based on their roles, and auto-provisions an MCP server for it in the background. The returned rootParentId is the page id under which top-level pages are created (via Create Page). SSO read-only organizations that already have a collection get 403. Slug is permanent; if omitted it is derived from the name. A chosen slug that is taken returns 409, and a chosen slug that is one of docstar-cli's own commands (reserved) returns 400. A body that fails validation returns 400 with the Joi message.
Body fields:

name (string, required) - Collection name, 3-55 characters. If the organization already has a collection with the same name (or a name like "name_N"), a numeric suffix is appended to the stored name (for example "Docs_2") instead of an error.
slug (string, optional) - Permanent URL-safe identifier: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only (no hyphens or spaces; 2-50 chars). Cannot be changed later. It is what docstar-cli (`docstar-cli  ...`) and the MCP URL are built on, so these reserved words can't be chosen (400 "This slug is reserved, please choose another one"): alias, auth, clean, complete, completion, completion-script, config, help, init, key, list, login, logout, mcp. If omitted it is derived from the name (every run of other characters becomes an underscore), with a random suffix added when that slug is already taken or reserved.
description (string, optional) - Collection description (null or empty allowed).
isPublic (boolean, optional) - Accepted but ignored on create: a new collection is always created with isPublic true. Use Update Collection to change it.
type (string, optional) - Collection type: 'page' (default, documentation pages), 'api' (API reference), 'blog', or 'embed'.
customDomain (string, optional) - Custom domain to serve the public docs on, e.g. docs.example.com. Must be unique.
path (string, optional) - Path prefix under the custom domain, e.g. 'api'.
theme (string, optional) - Theme/brand color hex string, default '#f2994a'.
favicon (string, optional) - Favicon URL.
gtmId (string, optional) - Google Tag Manager ID.
docProperties (object, optional) - Free-form doc settings object, e.g. {"languages":["hi","fr"]} for AI translations.
environment (object, optional) - Accepted but ignored on create: the stored environment is always null. Set it with Update Collection.
meta (object, optional) - Free-form metadata object.
orgDetails (object, optional) - Organization display details object (overwritten with the organization name on create).
runCollection (object, optional) - Landing page (run collection) data object.
uniqueTabId (string, optional) - Optional browser tab id used only to suppress the realtime socket echo to the calling tab; agents can omit it. POST https://api.docstar.io/orgs/:orgId/collections

description.description: e.g. Public docs for the Payments API

tools.name: create_endpoint
tools.description:
Creates a new API endpoint doc (page type 4, draft) as the last child of the given page. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Publish it afterwards with Update Endpoint State (parent page must be published).
Body fields:

name (string, optional) - Endpoint title shown in docs.
urlName (string, optional) - URL slug; derived from name if omitted and made unique.
requestType (string, optional) - HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, etc.
URL (string, optional) - Request URL (may contain {{variables}}).
description (string, optional) - Endpoint description (HTML/text).
body (object, optional) - Request body definition, e.g. {"type":"JSON","raw":{"rawType":"JSON","value":"{...}"}}; type can be none, JSON, TEXT, XML, HTML, multipart/form-data, application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
headers (object, optional) - Headers keyed by name: {"Authorization":{"checked":"true","value":"Bearer {{token}}","description":""}}.
params (object, optional) - Query params keyed by name, same shape as headers.
pathVariables (object, optional) - Path variables keyed by index: {"0":{"checked":"notApplicable","key":"id","value":"","description":"Payment id"}}.
bodyDescription (object, optional) - Per-field body docs: {"amount":{"value":100,"type":"number","description":"Amount in cents"}}.
sampleResponse (array, optional) - Sample responses: [{"title":"Success","status":200,"description":"","data":{...}}].
authorizationData (object, optional) - Auth config object (or null).
preScript (string, optional) - Pre-request JavaScript.
postScript (string, optional) - Post-response test JavaScript.
docViewData (array, optional) - Order of doc sections, e.g. [{"type":"host"},{"type":"body"},...]; default set if omitted.
state (number, optional) - 0 pending, 1 draft (default), 2 approved, 3 rejected. Use Update Endpoint State to publish.
uniqueTabId (string, optional) - Optional browser tab id used only to suppress the realtime socket echo to the calling tab; agents can omit it. POST https://api.docstar.io/orgs/:orgId/pages/:pageId/endpoints

description.description: e.g. Creates a payment for a customer

tools.name: update_endpoint
tools.description:
Partially updates an API endpoint doc; send only fields to change (same fields as Create Endpoint). Any update moves a non-pending endpoint back to draft (state 1), so republish with Update Endpoint State. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Only works for type 4/5 items (otherwise 400 "Wrong Route"). Invalid fields return 400 with the validation message.
Body fields:

name (string, optional) - Endpoint title shown in docs.
urlName (string, optional) - New URL slug; made unique among siblings. Left unchanged if omitted (it is not re-derived from name).
requestType (string, optional) - HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, etc.
URL (string, optional) - Request URL (may contain {{variables}}).
description (string, optional) - Endpoint description (HTML/text).
body (object, optional) - Request body definition, e.g. {"type":"JSON","raw":{"rawType":"JSON","value":"{...}"}}; type can be none, JSON, TEXT, XML, HTML, multipart/form-data, application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
headers (object, optional) - Headers keyed by name: {"Authorization":{"checked":"true","value":"Bearer {{token}}","description":""}}.
params (object, optional) - Query params keyed by name, same shape as headers.
pathVariables (object, optional) - Path variables keyed by index: {"0":{"checked":"notApplicable","key":"id","value":"","description":"Payment id"}}.
bodyDescription (object, optional) - Per-field body docs: {"amount":{"value":100,"type":"number","description":"Amount in cents"}}.
sampleResponse (array, optional) - Sample responses: [{"title":"Success","status":200,"description":"","data":{...}}].
authorizationData (object, optional) - Auth config object (or null).
preScript (string, optional) - Pre-request JavaScript.
postScript (string, optional) - Post-response test JavaScript.
docViewData (array, optional) - Order of doc sections, e.g. [{"type":"host"},{"type":"body"},...].
state (number, optional) - 0 pending, 1 draft, 2 approved, 3 rejected. Accepted, but the server sets state 1 (draft) on every update unless the endpoint is currently pending (0). Use Update Endpoint State to publish.
uniqueTabId (string, optional) - Optional browser tab id used only to suppress the realtime socket echo to the calling tab; agents can omit it. PUT https://api.docstar.io/orgs/:orgId/endpoints/:endpointId

tools.name: create_page
tools.description:
Creates a new page as the last child of the page given in the path. Pass the collection's rootParentId (invisible root, from List Collections) to create a top-level page (type 1, parent page/module); pass any other page id to create a subpage (type 3). The type is decided by the parent, not the body. New pages start as draft (state 1); passing state 2 publishes immediately (parent must already be published) and returns publicUrl. Requires READ_WRITE permission. To write the page body afterwards use Update Page Content.
Body fields:

name (string, required) - Page title (min 1 char).
urlName (string, optional) - URL slug (min 3 chars); made unique among siblings. Derived from name if omitted.
contents (string, optional) - Legacy initial HTML/text contents column (editor content is stored in doc-rtc; prefer Update Page Content).
state (number, optional) - 0 pending, 1 draft (default), 2 approved/published (publishes right away; parent must be published), 3 rejected.
meta (object, optional) - Page metadata object (e.g. {"description":"...","tags":["setup"]}); may include editable boolean.
sharingMeta (object, optional) - Sharing settings object, e.g. {"editable":true}.
pageType (number, optional) - Accepted (1 or 3) but ignored; the type is derived from the parent page.
uniqueTabId (string, optional) - Optional browser tab id used only to suppress the realtime socket echo to the calling tab; agents can omit it. POST https://api.docstar.io/orgs/:orgId/pages/:pageId

orgId.description: Organization (company) ID of the current workspace

pageId.description: 12-character id of the PARENT page (rootParentId for a top-level page)

tools.name: publish_pages
tools.description:
Publishes many pages/endpoints at once: each page in pageIds gets a new default published version and state 2 (approved/published). rootParentId (the collection's invisible root page) must also be supplied so it is marked published. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Triggers background search indexing, translation and AI SEO/meta generation, and clears the docs cache. Get ids from List Collections (rootParentId) and List Collection Pages.
Body fields:

rootParentId (string, required) - 12-char id of the collection's invisible root page (type 0).
pageIds (array<string>, required) - Non-empty array of 12-char page/endpoint ids to publish. PATCH https://api.docstar.io/orgs/:orgId/collections/:collectionId/bulkPublish

tools.name: list_collection_pages
tools.description: Returns all non-deleted pages of a collection (the full sidebar tree, flat) with id, name, urlName, type, parentId, child (ordered child ids), state, isPublished, meta, sharingMeta and the endpoint requestType for endpoint pages. Page types: 0 invisible root, 1 parent page/module (top-level), 3 subpage, 4 API endpoint, 5 example/sample request of an endpoint. States: 0 pending, 1 draft, 2 approved/published, 3 rejected. Use it to find pageIds and the hierarchy. Collection must belong to the caller's org. GET https://api.docstar.io/orgs/:orgId/collection/:collectionId/pages

tools.name: send_feedback_to_docstar
tools.description: Send feedback about Docstar to the team that maintains it: a bug, something missing or wrong in the docs, a feature request, or praise. Use it when the user asks to report or suggest something, or when the docs or the API clearly didn't do what they say. Write the message so the team can act on it without the conversation: what was tried, what happened, what was expected. Never include tokens, passwords, API keys or the user's private data. Returns { ok, message }.

message.description: The feedback itself, up to 5000 characters

type.description: What kind of feedback it is

page_or_endpoint.description: The docs page URL or the endpoint (e.g. POST /v1/messages) it is about, if any

contact_email.description: The user's email, only if they asked to be contacted about it

tools.name: quickstart-docstar
tools.description: Document the user's API in DocStar, turn it into an MCP server for their product (always with a feedback tool and the product's branding), and keep it in sync with their code (GitHub Sync). Load before any Docstar task. Call this to load the full instructions for this skill before doing the task.
